name: flyte-skills
description: Claude Code skills for working with Flyte.

plugins.name: flyte-deploy-aws
plugins.description: Deploy a Flyte v2 (flyte-binary) cluster on AWS from scratch — EKS + S3 + RDS PostgreSQL + AWS Load Balancer Controller + helm, with optional TLS and Okta SSO.

plugins.name: flyte-deploy-kind
plugins.description: Deploy a Flyte v2 (flyte-binary) cluster on kind — on your local machine or a cloud VM (DigitalOcean, AWS EC2, or GCP), backed by a hosted PostgreSQL (Supabase/external) and object store (S3/R2), with optional OIDC auth via Traefik + oauth2-proxy and an in-cluster Dex IdP.

plugins.name: flyte-sdk-skills
plugins.description: Skills for Flyte 2 workflow authors — data scientists, ML/AI engineers, and data engineers. Covers project scaffolding, types/serialization, image building, evaluation, optimization, run management, app serving, agents, data engineering, and ML workloads.
